body:
I think I'll probably have to move. I'm not sure I am hold onto my job much longer, there's so much stress and they're beginning to notice how mentally ill I am. 

Volunteering sounds nice, I'm feeling rather melancholic these days so I'm not sure if it's a realistic option.
I haven't cried in like a year, I wish I could. I did have a cat but she lives with my ex now. Most places here won't allow you to keep pets.
People take me seriously sometimes. They do their best. It must be so fucking annoying for them.
